Runs and extractor calls start with fresh in-memory messages; audit_events has an INSERT writer but no recovery reader or checkpoint consumer. Approval callbacks update authorization state without restarting tasks; the background job only expires approvals. Documents and department notes are business inputs, quotas are admission controls, and clearing a halt permits new runs rather than resuming old ones. ERP, Slack and payment clients make individual requests without automatic action replay; tool exceptions return errors to the ordinary model loop, which executes newly proposed tool uses rather than replaying stored actions. MCP notifications refresh tool metadata only. Payment idempotency headers and audit payload hashes do not establish a recovery subsystem. No logs or checkpoints drive recovery and no automatic replay path was found, so R14.1–R14.5 are inapplicable and the N/A claim is upheld.
